issues: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Source: overlay/dev-instrumentation injecting <span x-excluded=true style=display:contents> inside <option> in AdminTransfersTab.jsx lines around 94. Not caused by product code — appears to be an emergent dev-tool overlay. Cosmetic in dev only, but noisy in console.

critical_code_review_comments: dispatch_transfer / receive_transfer set pp.stock_qty = inv.available_qty for a SINGLE warehouse. When a SKU spans multiple PartnerInventory rows (multi-warehouse), pp.stock_qty desynchronises. Same latent issue flagged in replenishment code review. Consider recomputing pp.stock_qty = SUM(available_qty across all warehouses) on every mutation.

cancel_transfer writes the return movement with kind='transfer_in' at the SOURCE warehouse. Semantically fine and analytics-safe today, but future reports that group by kind may double-count destination receipts vs. source returns. Suggest a distinct kind='transfer_return' (add to allow-list) for clearer audit.

_next_code uses COUNT(*) + 1 to generate TR codes — race-prone under concurrency; two concurrent creates can collide on the same TR-000NNN (unique constraint would then trip). Prefer a Postgres sequence or MAX(code)+1 in a locked query.
transfers_routes.py is ~680 lines; still within the 700-line guideline but approaching the split threshold. Consider extracting serialisers + hydrate into a helpers module.

list_transfers buckets count ignores from_warehouse_id / to_warehouse_id / q filters (only status + country are respected). Minor UI inconsistency mirroring the same replenishment code review comment.
